name: Kawasaki Concours 14
engine: 1352 cc liquid-cooled inline four, variable valve timing, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: Kawasaki's sport tourer. Strong engine. Check the 2008-2012 recall and the ABS on high-mile bikes.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2008-2012 Concours 14s were in recall 12V343. Police-model bikes had several more.
A-002.reason: Open recalls are free to fix.

recalls.what: Kawasaki safety recall on 2008-2012 Concours 14 models. Check the VIN for details.
